bills.description: Prohibits intentional discrimination based on compelled speech with respect to using certain pronouns, names, or honorifics
bills.title: Prohibits intentional discrimination based on compelled speech with respect to using certain pronouns, names, or honorifics
pull_quotes: No employer shall terminate or take any other retaliatory action against an employee for misgendering or improper use of an individual's pronouns.

bills.description: Provides for the Restoring Biological Truth Act
bills.title: Provides for the Restoring Biological Truth Act
pull_quotes: 22B. "Sex" means an individual's biological sex, either male or female, as observed or clinically certified at birth. Gender identity and other subjective terms shall not be used as synonyms or substitutes for sex.
